# [PHP8.1]/[PHP8.0] PATCH for endpoint /api/products/{product_id}/ and /api/categories/{category_id} are NOK

Using PHP 8.1 & PHP8.0, The HTTP request PATCH for endpoint /api/products/{product_id}/ and /api/categories/{category_id} are NOK
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/190672765-b730a98f-3afd-4725-972e-82637f454b92.png)

PS: with PHP7.4 => OK

## Attendu
No, error displayed & persistent data

## Étapes
1. Go to BO > Advanced Parameters > Webservice page
2. Enable Webservice
3. Create a new webservice Key and enable the PATCH method
4. Using postman, try to PATCH for endpoint /api/products/{product_id}/
5. See error
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/190673201-630507a4-bc0a-42cc-b0dc-a5919d34ea94.png)
6. Using postman, try to PATCH for endpoint /api/categories/{category_id} 
7. See error 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/190673630-60afc125-d126-4569-9c02-4934f1ad5fe2.png)
